[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Robert Finley Glasgow was born in Adams County, Ohio on 12 Apr 1820.<ref>* Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p. 82</ref>. He was married to Nancy Jane Campbell, daughter of Robert  & Ann Glasgow Campbell in 1847 in Adams County, Ohio.  He was a farmer in Scott Township, Adams County, Ohio in the 1860 and 1860 US Federal Censuses.<ref>1850 United States Federal Census for Robt F Glasgow</ref><ref>1860 United States Federal Census for Robert S Glasgow</ref>. In 1866 they sold their farm to James Allison and moved to Illinois.<ref>* Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p. 82 </ref>
